newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Textile mulls 2-for-10 bonus.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Textile mulls 2-for-10 bonus.

text.p: Shenzhen Textile (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Thursday it planned to make a two-for-10 bonus share issue based on its capital reserves.
Shareholders have approved the plan and are waiting for permission from securities regulators, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The firm said it would omit a dividend based on its 1996 earnings. But it added it would issue distributable profits for 1996 along with 1997 dividend.
The company posted a net profit of 4.12 million yuan for 1996, down 60 percent from 10.23 million yuan in 1995.
